desc: 100% Damage, Attack Speed +1

name: Power Buff Lv. 2
desc: 200% Damage, Attack Speed +2

name: Pharaoh's Treasure Chest
desc: A treasure chest containing Pharaoh's precious items. Double-click to open.

name: Handmade Sandwich
desc: A sandwich made personally by Anna. Eat it in the morning to guarantee a sense of satisfaction all throughout the day.

name: Tasty Milk
desc: Fresh milk produced at the farm. \nRecovers around 100 HP.

name: Squeezed Juice
desc: Fresh juice produced at the farm. \nRecovers around 50 MP.

name: Seasoned Frog Eggs and Mushrooms
desc: A stinky dish made with Cursed Frog Eggs. Increases 400 HP if eaten.

name: Bloody Mushroom Wine
desc: A non-alcoholic wine made by the Witch using Cursed Cat Spittle. Increases 200 MP when consumed.

name: Slimy Canape
desc: A creepy and slimy Canape that the Witch has made for you. Increases Weapon ATT and Weapon DEF +15 for 15 minutes.

name: Zingy Kabab
desc: A suspiciously sharp-tasting Kabab that the Witch has made for you.  Increases Magic ATT And Magic DEF +15 for 15 minutes.

name: Swamp Wrap
desc: The Witch's wrap dish that fills your mouth with the aroma of the swamp with each bite. Increases Weapon ATT and Weapon DEF +25 for 15 minutes.

name: Rough Leather Steak
desc: A rough leather steak that the Witch has carefully grilled for you. Increases Magic ATT And Magic Defense +25 for 15 minutes.

name: Witch's Special Stew
desc: The Witch's special stew that gives off a sour stink. Increases Weapon and Magic ATT +40, Weapons and Magic DEF +100, and Speed and Jump +15 for 15 minutes.

name: Rose Scent
desc: As you are surrounded by the fragrant scent of Roses, you get a strange headache and your feet start to feel heavy. Go see Lana before the scent disappears.

name: Freesia Scent
desc: As you are surrounded by the refreshing scent of Freesias, you get a strange headache and your feet start to feel heavy. Go see Lana before the scent disappears.

name: Lavender Scent
desc: As you are surrounded by the sweet scent of Lavenders, you get a strange headache and your feet start to feel heavy. Go see Lana before the scent disappears.

name: Turkey Leg
desc: A huge roasted turkey leg. It's so big that it seems like it would take all day to finish eating.\n[Gives +30 Physical Attack for 3 minutes]

name: Return Scroll - Nearest Town
desc: Returns you to the nearest town.

name: Return Scroll to Lith Harbor
desc: Returns you to Lith Harbor.

name: Return Scroll to Ellinia
desc: Returns you to Ellinia.

name: Return Scroll to Perion
desc: Returns you to Perion.

name: Return Scroll to Henesys
desc: Returns you to Henesys.

name: Return Scroll to Kerning City
desc: Returns you to the dark Kerning City.

name: Return Scroll to Sleepywood
desc: Returns you to Sleepywood, a quiet and dark forest-town.

name: Return Scroll for Dead Mine
desc: Returns you to the dead mine at the higher ground of El Nath.nCan only be used in Orbis and El Nath.

name: Coffee Milk
desc: Returns you to the nearest town.

name: Strawberry Milk
desc: Returns you to Mushroom Shrine.

name: Fruit Milk
desc: Returns you to Showa Town.

name: Command Center Warp Capsule
desc: A warp capsule that allows the owner of the capsule to warp to the Command Center of Omega Sector.

name: Ludibrium Warp Capsule
desc: A warp capsule that returns you to Ludibrium.

name: Phyllia's Warp Powder
desc: Warp powder made by fairy Phyllia.  Teleports you to Magatia when used inside the Nihal desert region.

name: Nautilus Return Scroll
desc: This scroll enables you to return to the Pirate village, Nautilus. This is a one use item and will disappear after use.

name: Return to New Leaf City Scroll
desc: Use this scroll to venture back to New Leaf City whenever you want!

name: Masked Man's Invitation
desc: An invitation from the Masked Man to the Halloween Party at the Haunted Mansion. Double-click to move straight to the mansion.

name: Studio Invitation
desc: An invitation to the studio for the event "For Guild Only".

name: Invitation to the Moon
desc: An invitation to the moon, sent by the Moon Bunnies. Using this will send you directly to Moon Bunny's ????.

name: Invitation to the Nest
desc: An invitation to the baby bird's nest sent by Gaga. Use it to be sent directly to the nest.

name: Invitation to Ereve
desc: An invitation to Ereve from Neinheart. This invitation will allow you to instantly move to Ereve.

name: Family Studio Photo Coupon
desc: A coupon that allows you to attend the 6th Anniversary Family Photo Shoot Event.

name: Rien Teleport Ticket
desc: A teleport ticket given by the Maple Admin. It will immediately teleport you to Rien.

name: Richie Gold's Strange Lamp
desc: An unbelievable lamp made by Richie Gold. Use this, and you'll be led somewhere in in the maze. No one knows exactly where you'll be sent, though.

name: Portrait of an Orange Mushroom
desc: Drawing paper on which you can draw a portrait of an Orange Mushroom. The portrait of an Orange Mushroom can be completed by using the Amazing, Mystical, or Magical watercolor paint on it. \r\n#cCan be opened by double-clicking on it with the mouse.#

name: Portrait of an Octopus
desc: Drawing paper on which you can draw a portrait of an Octopus. The portrait of an Octupus can be completed by using the Amazing, Mystical, or Magical watercolor paint on it. \r\n#cCan be opened by double-clicking on it with the mouse.#

name: Dirty Treasure Map

name: Golden Chicken Effect
desc: Golden Chicken Effect was given as a reward for helping Lazy Daisy. You can turn it ON/OFF by double-clicking the icon or using the key configuration menu to assign a shortcut key.

name: Bummer Effect
desc: This effect is for people who helped Lazy Daisy but failed to hatch the egg. You can turn it ON/OFF by double-clicking the icon or using the key configuration menu to assign a shortcut key.

name: New Year's Card (Send)
desc: A beautiful card with season's greetings.

name: New Year's Card (Receive)
desc: A beautiful card with season's greetings. Double click on it to read!

name: Perfect Pitch
desc: This Music Note gives Inkwell the perfect pitch he's been dying to find. You can trade it for a rare item if you go to the Free Market Entrance or talk to Inkwell in Henesys before March 30th.
